# Portable Code Standard

Rules for AI agents to write neutral, portable code: no AI tool branding in the code, no lock-in to the platform that generated it, no secrets in the repository, and everything in English. Ships a free automated check that runs before every commit.

[![Download portable-code-standard.zip](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-portable--code--standard.zip-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/maikerobert/skills/releases/latest/download/portable-code-standard.zip)

## Before and after

```ts
// Generated by ChatGPT
import { platformAuth } from "@builder-platform/auth";
export class ManusAuthProvider {
  apiKey = "sk-proj-...";
}
```

```ts
import type { AuthProvider } from "./auth-provider";
export class SupabaseAuthProvider implements AuthProvider {
  constructor(private readonly apiKey = process.env.AUTH_API_KEY) {}
}
```

The first version signs the code with the tool's name, depends on the platform's own authentication and ships a key inside the repository. The second one sits behind a project-owned interface, reads its secret from the environment and runs anywhere.

## The 6 rules

1. **Neutral authorship:** no AI or tool names in identifiers, files, comments or commits.
2. **Platform independence:** auth, database, storage, email, payments and hosting from the project's chosen providers, behind project-owned interfaces, with versioned migrations and `.env.example`.
3. **Secrets out of the code:** no keys, tokens or passwords in the code or its history.
4. **English in the code:** identifiers, tables, columns, comments and commit messages in English; end-user text follows the product's language.
5. **Clean repository:** no tool leftovers, dead code or forgotten debugging.
6. **Automated checks:** the included Git hooks block violations before they leave your machine.

## Install

**As a skill:** [download the .zip](https://github.com/maikerobert/skills/releases/latest/download/portable-code-standard.zip) and upload it in the Skills area of Claude or ChatGPT, or unzip it into `~/.claude/skills/` (Claude Code) or `~/.agents/skills/` (Codex).

**In a repository, with or without the skill:**

```bash
mkdir -p scripts
cp portable-code-standard/scripts/*.sh scripts/
bash scripts/install-hooks.sh              # pre-commit and commit-msg hooks
bash scripts/check-portability.sh --all    # check the whole repository
```

Then paste `references/agents-md-block.md` into the repository's `AGENTS.md`, so any agent that opens the project follows the same rules. For a server-side check, copy `assets/portability.yml` to `.github/workflows/` (free on public repositories).

## Em português

Regras para a IA escrever código neutro e portável: sem o nome dela no código, sem prender o sistema à plataforma que o gerou, sem segredos no repositório e tudo em inglês. Traz uma verificação automática e gratuita que roda antes de cada commit. Baixe o `.zip` pelo botão acima.
